title: Crash on exit when compiled with profiler
body:
### Tested versions

- Tested on master Godot v4.8.dev (4b03d5558) 
- Probably since https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/121161 since that is where the crash condition was added. (cc @Ivorforce)

### System information

Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors (2400x1350 @ 60.00 Hz, 1920x1080 @ 60.00 Hz) - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 (NVIDIA; 32.0.16.1088) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-10750H CPU @ 2.60GHz (12 threads) - 15.82 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

```
ERROR: FATAL: Condition "!is_main_thread_assigned.clear_if_set()" is true.
   at: Thread::release_main_thread (C:\Projects\godotsrc\godot\core/os/thread.cpp:101)

================================================================
CrashHandlerException: Program crashed
Engine version: Godot Engine v4.8.dev.custom_build (4b03d555837093ea1e3ca1d28eda4c73534e0fe7)
Dumping the backtrace.
Load address: 7ff705030000

[0] 7ff70be69db1 (main+6e39db1) - Thread::release_main_thread (C:\Projects\godotsrc\godot\core\os\thread.cpp:101)
[1] 7ff7051bbb2f (main+18bb2f) - Main::cleanup (C:\Projects\godotsrc\godot\main\main.cpp:5371)
[2] 7ff70518feec (main+15feec) - widechar_main (C:\Projects\godotsrc\godot\platform\windows\godot_windows.cpp:109)
[3] 7ff70518ffc3 (main+15ffc3) - _main (C:\Projects\godotsrc\godot\platform\windows\godot_windows.cpp:132)
[4] 7ff705190002 (main+160002) - main (C:\Projects\godotsrc\godot\platform\windows\godot_windows.cpp:146)
[5] 7ff70518fbdd (main+15fbdd) - WinMain (C:\Projects\godotsrc\godot\platform\windows\godot_windows.cpp:160)
[6] 7ff70ce07ee6 (main+7dd7ee6) - __scrt_common_main_seh (D:\a\_work\1\s\src\vctools\crt\vcstartup\src\startup\exe_common.inl:288)
[7] 7ff7050e473a (main+b473a) - ShimMainCRTStartup (C:\Projects\godotsrc\godot\platform\windows\cpu_feature_validation.c:74)
[8] 7fffc6d1ccb7 (kernel32.dll+2ccb7) - BaseThreadInitThunk
-- END OF C++ BACKTRACE --
================================================================
```

It doesn't crash when I compile without profiler support. Have not tried other profilers besides tracy. Tracy is otherwise working fine.

Using breakpoints, it looks like `make_main_thread()` is only ever called when `caller_id == MAIN_ID`, so `is_main_thread_assigned` never gets set and then it crashes when it tries to clear it later in `release_main_thread`.

Happens in project manager, the editor, running projects, and when running tests.

My build command is `scons dev_build=yes dev_mode=yes scu_build=yes ninja=yes angle=no profiler=tracy profiler_path="C:\Projects\godotsrc\godot/../tracy/tracy" `, on Windows using msvc and tracy v0.14.1.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Compile with profiler.
2. Run project manager.
3. Close the window.

N/A
